title: Reaction to Communion cover at Beth Israel
summary: Jim Weiner tells of Reaction to Communion cover at Beth Israel, about late 1980s at Beth Israel Hospital, Boston, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and when I saw the face on the cover I flipped out.

plain: Jim Weiner, a man who tells of being abducted by aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels about seeing the cover of Communion, a book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own encounters, in the late 1980s at Beth Israel Hospital in Boston. Weiner says that when he saw the face on the cover he "flipped out." He tells it because the face seemed to match what he had experienced.
